snippet.title: Cozy Potions - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Find comfort in bubbling cauldrons and blooming gardens. Craft potions, nurture plants, unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and sip your own brews for cozy buffs as your tiny alchemist’s shop becomes the town’s favourite haven.

WISHLIST HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3709760/Cozy_Potions_The_Alchemists_Shop/

Coming Soon on PC and Nintendo Switch
